pins.notes: Terminal; two-terminal non-polarized metal-plate resistor, the datasheet gives no pin names or numbers.

layout_notes.text: Recommended land pattern for LR2512 2 W, 0.8-4 mohm: a = 3.05 mm (pad length), b = 3.68 mm (pad width), i = 1.27 mm (gap between pads).
Resistance after soldering varies slightly with land size and solder amount; account for the resulting increase or decrease when designing the circuit.
Resistance is measured at points A = 5.25 +/- 0.25 mm, B = 2.25 +/- 0.25 mm on the back electrodes of LR2512 (measurement position drawing); place Kelvin sense take-offs consistently with this.
Reflow per J-STD-020D profile; soldering iron 350 +/- 10 C for less than 3 s.
Product is sensitive to transient overloads above its specification; avoid them in manufacturing and use.

gaps: Datasheet is in Traditional Chinese except the tables; values were read from the rendered pages (p3, p4, p22) as the text layer splits table cells.
Two-terminal non-polarized part: no pin names or numbers in the datasheet; names '1'/'2' are a convention for symbol mapping.

The rated current and overload current columns (p2-p3) give only the formulas Ir = sqrt(P/R) and Io = sqrt(5P/R); p4 says if the computed value exceeds the highest current in the table, the highest rated current applies, but no numeric maximum current is printed for 2512.
No pulse or surge energy rating (e.g. inrush 20 A for 100 ms); only the 5 x rated power / 5 s short-time overload test (p10).
No dedicated 4-terminal (Kelvin) land pattern; the recommended land pattern is a plain 2-pad layout (p22).
No thermal resistance or terminal temperature data; derating is vs ambient temperature only (p4).
Alloy for 2512 2 W below 3.5 mohm is copper-manganese (p9); the magnetic-material and thermal-EMF warnings (p25) apply to iron-chromium-aluminium and nickel-copper alloys, not to this value.
Body dimensions (L 6.248 mm, W 3.202 mm, p6) not stored; the H/T1 values for the 0.8-3 mohm 2 W row are not unambiguous in the text layer.
Tolerance F: the D (+/-0.5 %) range for 2512 2 W is 1-50 mohm, the F/G/J range 0.3-500 mohm (p3); 2 mohm F is in range.
